lines.zh: 我只有一格长，游得却很快。
lines.en: I am one block long but swim fast.

lines.zh: 橘色的我贴着珊瑚缝钻。
lines.en: Orange as I am, I thread the coral gaps.

lines.zh: 两条同伴跟着我，一共三条。
lines.en: Two schoolmates follow; that makes three.

lines.zh: 白带子在水中一明一暗。
lines.en: My white bands flicker in and out.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋的礁石，我熟得很。
lines.en: I know these warm-water reef stones well.

lines.zh: 我绕一圈又回来，专走老路。
lines.en: I circle and return along my old route.

lines.zh: 我比水草还轻，晃一下就过。
lines.en: I am lighter than the weeds and slip past.

lines.zh: 五条小丑鱼挤在一条缝里。
lines.en: Five clownfish squeeze into one crevice.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面冲，尾巴打水。
lines.en: I skim the sand, tail beating water.

lines.zh: 前面有块石头，我钻过去。
lines.en: A stone ahead; I slip underneath it.
My fins are small but they work hard.
I swim slowly through the coral's shadow.
We swim from the reef top to its base.

lines.zh: 我停下来，等后面那两条。
lines.en: I stop and wait for the two behind me.

lines.zh: 海葵的触手间，我钻出来。
lines.en: I slip out between the anemone's tentacles
When my school scatters, I scatter with it

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚枝里悬着，很稳。
lines.en: I hover among coral branches, quite steady.

lines.zh: 我的白带在暗处也看得见。
lines.en: My white bands show even in shadow.
This rock slit holds me and no more.
I wait for the current to bring insects.
Two schoolmates dawdle on my left.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的触手碰到我了，痒。
lines.en: A coral tentacle brushes me; it tickles.
The warm water soaks me; I grow sleepy.
My mouth opens and shuts, softly.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在珊瑚上，很小。
lines.en: My shadow on the coral is very small.
I sway with the surface, using no effort.

lines.zh: 礁石下面比上面凉一些。
lines.en: Under the reef it is cooler than above.
I hear a boat knocking far away.

lines.zh: 我在想那粒骨粉的味道。
lines.en: I am thinking about that bonemeal's taste.

lines.zh: 谁也不想先动，那就都别动。
lines.en: Nobody wants to move first, so nobody does.

lines.zh: 你蹲在水边，脸比礁石白。
lines.en: You crouch at the water, paler than the reef.

lines.zh: 我游到离你一指的地方。
lines.en: I swim to within a finger of you.
You are so large and I am tiny.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle twice inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，得用很小的网。
lines.en: To catch me you need a tiny net.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子都酸了。
lines.en: Looking up this long makes my neck ache.
One of your fingers outgrows me.
I will not run; I want to look at you.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我抖了一下。
lines.en: When you blink, I twitch in fright.
Do not slap the water; it startles me.
The whole of me got knocked crooked.
Blood seeps through my white band.
I am too small for a blow like that.

lines.zh: 我钻进珊瑚，谁也别找我。
lines.en: I burrow into coral; nobody find me.
Not one schoolmate is in sight.
My fin is shaking and will not stop.
It hurts; I press against stone and freeze.

lines.zh: 我连游直的力气都没了。
lines.en: I lack the strength to swim straight.

lines.zh: 血把周围的水染了一点。
lines.en: Blood tints the water around me.
I must hide and catch my breath.
There is a crumb on your fingertip.
I dart over, then halt half a block short.

lines.zh: 这味道是甜的，不是海味。
lines.en: It smells sweet, not of the sea.
Two schoolmates tried it; they are fine.
I open and suck; the crumb is gone.

lines.zh: 你手心朝上，像一块礁石。
lines.en: Your palm faces up like a flat stone.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手游了三圈。
lines.en: Three laps around your hand, then I stop.
Sprinkle more; I am not full yet.

lines.zh: 这比礁石上的小虫好吃。
lines.en: This beats the little bugs on the reef.
One move from you and I retreat to coral.

lines.zh: 你手指碰到我，我翻了个身。
lines.en: Your finger touched me; I rolled over.
I am so small you felt nothing.
That bump slid me into the rock gap.
The current churns and I cannot hold steady.
Three schoolmates got swept apart.

lines.zh: 我的白带被压得折了一下。
lines.en: One white band got creased by the knock.
Do not poke with your finger; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我绕开你的膝盖，继续游。
lines.en: I round your knee and keep swimming.

lines.zh: 水一下子浑了，我看不见。
lines.en: Silt fills the water and blinds me.
I steady myself and flick away.

lines.zh: 我要找那条橘得最正的。
lines.en: I want the one with the truest orange.
We dance side by side, fins quivering.
Her white bands are wider than mine.

lines.zh: 这条石缝够我们两个住。
lines.en: This rock crevice is room enough for two.

lines.zh: 她转过来，用头碰我的头。
lines.en: She turns and touches her head to mine.
In a few days there will be four small ones.
We keep watch over this patch of reef.

lines.zh: 水流会把卵带到珊瑚下。
lines.en: The current will carry the eggs under the coral.
When she leaves, I follow right after.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，像两块斑。
lines.en: We press together like two bright patches.

lines.zh: 沙上有个亮片，我去顶它。
lines.en: A bright flake on the sand; I nudge it.
It is bigger than me and will not move.
I try to grip it; it slips free.
Bonemeal dusts my mouth white.
This is a shell, not a bug.

lines.zh: 我用头顶着它游了一格。
lines.en: I headbutt it along for one block.
The iron scrap is too heavy; I quit.
Schoolmates gather, all wanting a look.

lines.zh: 我叼着它塞进珊瑚底下。
lines.en: I hide it beneath the coral.
Never mind; I will look for food instead.
A big fish is circling beyond the reef.
A black shape drops over my head.
A raw new smell has entered the water.
Every schoolmate has ducked into coral.

lines.zh: 那条海鳝把头探出来了。
lines.en: That moray has poked its head out.
The net above is sinking toward us.
I fix on the swaying line.
Footsteps have entered the shallows.
Its eye has not left me once.
I shrink into coral, only my head out.
I watch it from inside the crevice.
It is too big for me to bite.
I slip around behind its back.
Two schoolmates guard the other side.
Each time it moves, the coral blocks it.
I wait for it to turn its head.

lines.zh: 我的橘色在珊瑚里不明显。
lines.en: My orange hides well among the coral.
Half a block more and I can bite.

lines.zh: 它要是冲进来，我就散开。
lines.en: If it charges in, we scatter.
I count the opening and closing of its gills.
I charge and bite its mouth.
My teeth are small and they grip hard.
One shake of its head hurls me away.

lines.zh: 一条同伴也咬了它的鳍。
lines.en: A schoolmate bit its fin too.
I bite, then dive back into coral.
The pain made it flinch.
This time my own fin tore too.
Four of us go at it together.
It backs off, so we stop chasing.
A small red wisp floats up.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚的影子里出来。
lines.en: I come out from the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋，我生在这块礁。
lines.en: I was born on this warm-water reef.

lines.zh: 四条同伴跟我一起来了。
lines.en: Four schoolmates came along with me.

lines.zh: 我先找一条能藏身的缝。
lines.en: First I look for a crevice to hide in.
This water is warmer than I remember.
I am so small the coral looks tall.
A large fish passes in the distance.
I wiggle my white bands and learn the way.
The sand is soft; I settle lightly.
I dart into the coral crevice.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我的橘色更亮了。
lines.en: The water burns; my orange looks brighter.
I fell from the surface onto coral.

lines.zh: 我活在水里，却憋得发慌。
lines.en: I live in water, yet I am suffocating.

lines.zh: 冲击把珊瑚整丛掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flipped an entire coral clump.

lines.zh: 箭擦过白带，划开一道口。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my band and cut it.

lines.zh: 光缠住我，橘色都发白了。
lines.en: Light wraps me until my orange pales.
Every little bug on the reef is gone.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea and froze me.

lines.zh: 珊瑚不见了，我一直在掉。
lines.en: The coral is gone and I keep falling.
